Cloudflare put 2,500 tools into one MCP server

Comment MCP and I’ll DM you the full setup guide.
Send this to someone whose AI keeps running out of memory.

The old way: every tool gets loaded into your AI’s memory.
→ 2,500+ Cloudflare endpoints = 1,170,523 tokens
→ more than your AI can even hold

The new way, Code Mode:
→ your AI finds the one tool it needs
→ writes a tiny program to use it
→ runs it in a sandbox and gets back only the answer
→ about 1,100 tokens for the whole API

What you get: DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust and the rest of your Cloudflare account, from one chat.

Setup is one line in Claude Code:
claude mcp add —transport http cloudflare https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp

The numbers are Cloudflare’s own, from the cloudflare/mcp repo on GitHub.
